117585.name: Chabad House of Greater Hartford
117585.note: CrownHeights.info, 15 Apr 2012: 'since 1977, when he and wife Miriam were sent to Hartford to establish the first Chabad House in Connecticut' (Rabbi Yosef Gopin); 'Thirty-five years after the Chabad-Lubavitch movement established a presence in greater Hartford'. Jewish Ledger, 6 July 2011: 'In 1977, the Rebbe established a presence in Connecticut by agreeing to send Rabbi Yosef and Rebbetzin Miriam Gopin to Hartford'.

117624.name: Chabad House At Amherst
117624.note: CrownHeights.info, 18 Apr 2024: 'aside from Chabad at Amherst, which opened in 1974, there are additional Chabad centers in Northampton, Greenfield and Pittsfield.' Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

117584.name: Chabad of Stamford
117584.note: CrownHeights.info, 28 Mar 2024 (Joseph Lieberman obituary): 'Rabbi Yisrael Deren, a longtime family friend who, with his wife Vivi, established Chabad of Stamford in 1988.' Rabbi Moshe Shemtov directs it now. Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

118218.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Greenwich
118218.note: Its own welcome page (read through Firecrawl), Rabbi Yossi and Maryashie Deren: 'a few days before Rosh Hashanah in 1996, we rented a small one-bedroom apartment in Glenville.'

118223.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Westport
118223.note: CrownHeights.info, 3 July 2026: 'When Chabad acquired the landmark around 2012, the Kantors had already been serving the community since 1997 from various temporary spaces.' CrownHeights.info, 7 Feb 2012: the Kantors 'relocated to Westport 14 years ago, starting their congregation with religious study groups at the Kantors' home on Sniffen Road'.

118238.name: Chabad Lubavitch Northwest Connecticut
118238.note: Litchfield County Times on CrownHeights.info, 17 Aug 2006 ('Chabad of Northwest Corner Celebrates Decade of Growth'): 'Eleven years ago, Rabbi Joseph Eisenbach and his wife, Mina, followed their religious faith and passion to Litchfield.' Jewish Ledger, 6 July 2011: 'in the mid-'90s, when Rabbi Joseph Eisenbach came to Litchfield'. Medium: counted back (about 1995; the 'decade' suggests 1996).

118334.name: Chabad of the Farmington Valley
118334.note: Jewish Ledger, 6 July 2011: 'Residents of Farmington Valley communities who came to Chabad House asked for more local programs, and in 1998, Rabbi Mendel Samuels was brought in to start Chabad of the Valley in Weatogue.' Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

118472.name: Chabad Jewish Center
118472.note: Jewish Ledger, 6 July 2011: 'In 2001, Rabbi Yosef Wolvovsky came to UConn, then brought Chabad to Glastonbury to serve communities east of the Connecticut River'. Jewish Ledger on CrownHeights.info, 25 May 2007: 'Six years ago, Rabbi Yosef Wolvovsky and his wife Yehudis ran the fledgling Chabad: East of the River from their small two bedroom apartment in Glastonbury.' Now the Benet Rothstein Chabad Jewish Center.

118604.name: Chabad of Berkshire County
118604.note: CrownHeights.info, 20 Aug 2007: 'Volovik and his wife arrived in Pittsfield three years ago to establish a new Chabad House.' Medium: counted back; its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (July 2004).

117628.name: Lubavitch Yeshiva Academy
117628.note: CrownHeights.info, 21 Jan 2019, on LYA: the Frierdiker Rebbe 'sent the first shliach, Rabbi Sholom Ber Gordon, to Springfield in 1945 to open a yeshiva'; in January 1950 Rabbi Dovid Edelman was asked to take over as principal of the yeshiva. Medium: the year he was sent, not a stated opening date.

120140.name: The Friendship Circle
120140.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 June 2012: 'celebrating the 10th anniversary of the Friendship Circle of Fairfield County, an organization founded by the Chabad Lubavitch in Fairfield County'. Medium: counted back. (Two listings of the same Friendship Circle.)

159690.name: The Friendship Circle
159690.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 June 2012: 'celebrating the 10th anniversary of the Friendship Circle of Fairfield County, an organization founded by the Chabad Lubavitch in Fairfield County'. Medium: counted back. (Two listings of the same Friendship Circle.)

159799.name: Chabad Chevra at University of Hartford - Rohr Chabad House
159799.note: CrownHeights.info, 15 Apr 2012: 'Rabbi Yosef Kulek has led Chabad Chevra at the university since 2000, when student activities were held at Chabad House of greater Hartford on Albany Avenue'; the Gopins had 'engaged a series of part-time rabbis at the university, finally bringing in the Kuleks as fulltime directors 12 years ago.' Medium: the first full-time directors; part-time campus work came earlier. The house near campus was bought in 2009.

299902.name: Chabad at UConn - The Rohr Jewish Student Center
299902.note: CrownHeights.info, 3 Nov 2005: Rabbi Shlomo Hecht, 'his wife and two young sons, arrived in Storrs this past summer'. CrownHeights.info, 30 July 2013: 'The Hechts has been serving the Jewish students at UConn since 2005.' Its chabad.org listing went up 2 Aug 2005.

1194917.name: Chabad New Canaan Jewish Center
1194917.note: CrownHeights.info, 27 Sept 2012: 'Rabbi Mendelow said he moved to New Canaan from Stamford more than two years ago because he realized there was a need for a Jewish community.' Medium: counted back; its chabad.org listing went up 27 Apr 2010.

6152638.name: Jewish Riverside Old Greenwich
6152638.note: Lubavitch.com, 4 Jan 2024: 'Rabbi Boruch and Chaya Ceitlin, who recently launched Chabad of Old Greenwich and neighboring Riverside'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2 Nov 2023.
